MORE INFO ON THE BRUSH:
Brush #59 – 1 individual Procreate brush from the ‘Abstract Suite Collection’ series of Procreate Brushes in this shop (ZaraRozaDesigns)
-This brush has pressure sensitive size. Pressing harder and the width of the line will get bigger, press lighter and the line width will get narrower. 
IMPORTING THE BRUSH TO PROCREATE:
-Go to downloads on your ipad or the location you downloaded the .brush file to.
